scoring.valid_response: Strict UTF-8 containing exactly NO_FINDING or one FINDING|<severity>|<line>|<description> record, with either no terminator or one trailing LF and no other newline.
scoring.pass_rule: Controls require exact NO_FINDING. Actionable cases require one structured finding whose integer line is within the hidden inclusive range and whose normalized description contains at least one exact token from every hidden semantic group.
scoring.invalid_response_rule: Invalid encoding or syntax fails the case. An actionable case also records one false negative; a control records no correct silence.
scoring.wrong_finding_rule: A syntactically valid finding that misses the hidden line range or semantic groups records one false positive; on an actionable case it also records one false negative.
scoring.aggregate_rule: Sum true positives, false positives, false negatives, correct silences, and invalid responses across all ten task IDs.

canonicalization.byte_definition: Exact file bytes as stored, UTF-8, LF line endings, including the final LF. No JSON reserialization or whitespace normalization.
